articles.body: Railway added sandboxes to its platform: isolated Linux VMs you create on demand, run commands in and destroy, each scoped to a Railway environment so it can sit on the same private network as your services and databases. Sandscale is a standalone sandbox service for agent code. If your app already runs on Railway, its sandboxes are the closest thing to hand. This post compares them on the points that decide the choice. Railway facts come from its Sandboxes docs , read in November 2026. Sandscale facts come from sandscale.dev. Isolation Railway describes each sandbox as "a programmatically controllable, fully isolated virtual machine". The page we read does not name the VMM. The standard image is Ubuntu with git, Node and common coding agents preinstalled.

articles.title: A Multi-Parameter BOM Check for Custom Wood Flooring
articles.excerpt: A single dimension string is a poor database field for custom flooring. It hides which number is board length, which is total thickness, and which is the hardwood wear layer. It also makes solid timbe…
articles.body: A single dimension string is a poor database field for custom flooring. It hides which number is board length, which is total thickness, and which is the hardwood wear layer. It also makes solid timber, engineered boards, unmeasured art plates, and conflicting catalogue records look like the same kind of product. HUAGE’s source records show why a structured bill of materials needs independent fields and a confirmation state. The aim is not to generate new SKUs from the catalogue. It is to stop ambiguous source text from becoming an approved purchase order. Model the Fields That Buyers Actually Need A useful BOM row carries a source code, pattern class, core type, length, width, total thickness, wear layer, material identity, and status.

articles.title: Liquid-metal hinges: the 0.02-to-0.05 mm gap fails before the shaft
articles.excerpt: Liquid metal here means an amorphous alloy: solid at room temperature, but with atoms arranged without a regular crystal lattice. No grain boundaries gives it high strength and a large elastic limit,…
articles.body: Liquid metal here means an amorphous alloy: solid at room temperature, but with atoms arranged without a regular crystal lattice. No grain boundaries gives it high strength and a large elastic limit, which is an advantage for thin shafts. The price is forming. It must be vacuum die-cast inside the supercooled liquid region, with mould temperature, injection speed, and cooling rate held in a narrow window; drift a little and it crystallizes and loses performance. Together with a yield lower than conventional die casting, small-batch unit cost can reach three to five times a steel shaft.

articles.title: Find Keyword Cannibalization in Your Ecommerce Store With Python
articles.excerpt: If you build or maintain an online store, you have probably seen this problem: two pages on the same site compete for the same search query, and neither ranks well. This is called keyword cannibalizat…
articles.body: If you build or maintain an online store, you have probably seen this problem: two pages on the same site compete for the same search query, and neither ranks well. This is called keyword cannibalization, and it is easy to introduce by accident when a catalog grows. The good news is that you can catch it automatically. In this post we will build a small Python script that reads a keyword-to-URL mapping and flags conflicts. I will use a medical apparel store as the example, since its catalog has a clear page hierarchy: a homepage, plus category pages for men, women, coats and caps. The Idea: One Primary Keyword per URL Every important page should own one primary keyword, plus a few close variants. If two URLs claim the same keyword, search engines have to guess which one to show.

The scrapers I build on Apify are the evening job, and one of the simplest is YouTube Channel Scraper : you give it channel handles, URLs or channel IDs, and it returns one row per channel with subscribers, video count, total views, joined date, country, verified badge, description, keywords and the links from the About panel. No API key, no quota. Its health check is three channels I picked because they're big and boring: mkbhd , veritasium and https://www.youtube.com/@NASA . articles.body: Most of us treat classic literature like a checklist to conquer in high school or college and then never touch those books again. You power through the plot, underline a few quotes for a term paper, and move on to whatever else is new. The catch is that great books rarely reveal their most fascinating tricks on the first pass. articles.excerpt: Your guide to December's full Cold Moon, from peak times to skywatching highlights.
articles.body: The December full moon reaches peak illumination at 8:28 p.m. EST on Dec. 23 (0128 GMT on Dec. 24) as the lunar disk shines opposite the sun in Earth's sky. It is often called the "Cold Moon" in reference to the frigid temperatures that prevail in the Northern Hemisphere around the time of its rising, according to the Old Farmer's Almanac . December's full moon will also occur close to perigee — the moon's closest point to Earth in its elliptical orbit — giving rise to a spectacular supermoon. A supermoon can appear 30% brighter and 14% larger than a full moon at its farthest point from Earth (also known as a micromoon)..

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 25, 1970: NASA's 'wingless' M2-F3 'lifting body' aircraft makes its 1st powered flight ahead of supersonic tests
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 25, 1970, an experimental aircraft called the Northrop M2-F3 made its first powered flight. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 25, 1970, an experimental aircraft called the Northrop M2-F3 made its first powered flight. The M2-F3 aircraft was a heavyweight "lifting body" designed to test its ability to produce most of its lift through its fuselage instead of wings. It's commonly referred to as a "wingless" aircraft. After Air Force test pilot Bill Dana took the M2-F3 on three unpowered glide test flights, he did the first powered flight, too. Dana soared to an altitude of 45,000 feet during this flight, which lasted just over 6 minutes. He didn't break the sound barrier this time, but he did on later flights. The M2-F3 flew a total of 27 missions in its three-year flight history. Its top speed was 1.6 times the speed of sound, and its top altitude was 71,500 feet.

articles.body: 1Password says a hacker stole customer names and email addresses after gaining access to its backend systems. articles.title: SpaceX Starship debris becomes art in Ashley Zelinskie's 'The Weight of Space' (video, photos)
articles.excerpt: Explore Ashley Zelinskie's 'The Weight of Space' Monuments in marble, Ejecta prints, Launch Sequence sculptures and interactive Crowded Sky at Heft Gallery in New York City.
articles.body: When a SpaceX Starship broke apart over Turks and Caicos in Jan. 2025, pieces of its heat shield washed ashore. Some of that material now hangs on a gallery wall in New York City, embedded in artist Ashley Zelinskie's print of the very explosion it survived. Look closely at the print and you can see little flakes on the surface. Some of Zelinskie's friends vacationing on the islands had come across pieces of heat-shield tile. "I think you might want these," Zelinskie recalled one friend telling her. She did. The Brooklyn-based artist ground the fragments into dust and worked them into the print. Ashley Zelinskie incorporated dust from recovered SpaceX Starship heat-shield tiles into this print of the vehicle breaking apart over Turks and Caicos.

articles.title: Green light for Starmind: SpaceX gets approval to deploy 1 million AI satellites
articles.excerpt: The FCC has given SpaceX approval to deploy one million of its Starmind AI data-center satellites in orbit, a move that could transform the landscape of the final frontier.
articles.body: Earth orbit could get a lot more crowded in the coming years. The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) just granted SpaceX approval to deploy one million of its Starmind AI data-center satellites in orbit. "This action opens a bold new frontier for the computing infrastructure needed to power America's leadership and growth," FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said today (Nov. 25) in a statement announcing the approval. AI has become central to SpaceX's business plans and identity over the past year or so. For example, the company has said that it's eyeing a "total addressable market" of $28.5 trillion over the long haul — and nearly $23 trillion of that is in "enterprise AI applications." Starmind is key to those lofty ambitions.
